description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $120 per hour 
 
 Join a leading AI research initiative focused on developing next-generation artificial intelligence systems capable of advanced financial reasoning and investment analysis. We are seeking experienced Equity Research professionals to contribute their expertise toward training and evaluating AI models that analyze financial statements, public company disclosures, and investment research.
 In this role, you will apply your knowledge of equity research and SEC filings to create, review, and evaluate high-quality financial content that enhances AI models' analytical capabilities.
 This is a remote, contract-based opportunity offering flexible working hours and the chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI innovation.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Evaluate Financial Analysis
 Review AI-generated financial analyses for accuracy, completeness, and analytical rigor.
 Assess the quality of investment reasoning and financial interpretations.
 Provide detailed written feedback to improve model performance.
 Analyze Public Company Filings
 Interpret and extract insights from public company disclosures, including SEC filings and financial statements.
 Validate AI-generated summaries and ensure accurate representation of financial information.
 Develop Financial Evaluation Tasks
 Create challenging, real-world equity research scenarios for AI training and evaluation.
 Contribute to the development of structured financial datasets and assessment criteria.
 Collaborate with Research Teams
 Work alongside AI researchers and financial subject matter experts to improve evaluation methodologies.
 Help establish consistent standards for financial reasoning and investment analysis.
 
 Required Qualifications
 Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in Equity Research at a recognized financial institution or investment firm.
 Hands-on experience analyzing and extracting insights from SEC filings, including annual reports, quarterly reports, and other public disclosures.
 Strong understanding of:
 Financial statement analysis
 Company valuation concepts
 Equity research methodologies
 Public market investing
 Corporate financial reporting
 Excellent analytical, written, and communication skills.
 High attention to detail with the ability to evaluate complex financial information accurately.
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience preparing equity research reports or investment recommendations.
 Familiarity with financial modeling and valuation techniques.
 Knowledge of capital markets, accounting principles, and corporate finance.
 Interest in artificial intelligence, financial technology, or AI-assisted investment research.
 Experience reviewing financial content or participating in quality assurance initiatives.
 
 Engagement Details
 Fully remote independent contractor engagement.
 Flexible work schedule completed on your own time.
 Minimum commitment of 10 hours per week.
 Initial engagement of at least four weeks, with opportunities for extension based on project needs and performance.
 Weekly payments through supported payment platforms.
 
 Why Join
 Help advance AI systems capable of sophisticated financial reasoning.
 Apply your equity research expertise to high-impact AI development projects.
 Collaborate with leading researchers and finance professionals.
 Contribute to the future of AI-powered investment analysis and financial intelligence.
 
 Equal Opportunity Statement
 All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.
 
 Contract Information
 Independent contractor engagement.
 Fully remote work completed on your own schedule.
 Projects may be extended, shortened, or concluded based on business needs and individual performance.
 Work does not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.
 Weekly payments are processed through supported payment platforms based on approved work completed.
 Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this opportunity.
